title: Cross-Desk Reference — The Coverage Amount a Statement Presents, Belrose Promotional Financing Plans
content:
# Cross-Desk Reference — The Coverage Amount a Statement Presents, Belrose Promotional Financing Plans

Where a piece financed on a Belrose Promotional Financing Plan is covered under the Belrose Jewelry Protection and Care Plans, the statement for the cycle may present an amount for that coverage. The finance desk reads the standing of the coverage, its premium arrangement, whether any claim has been settled under it, and the premium it charges for one month.

| The care coverage on a financed piece | The amount presented for coverage |
|---|---|
| Stands in force, and its premium is collected month by month | The premium that coverage charges for one month |
| Stands in force, and no claim has been settled under it | This desk's coverage presentation amount of **2.00 USD** |
| Any other case, including a financed piece with no coverage | Nothing is presented for coverage |

The first row governs first: coverage in force whose premium is collected month by month presents that monthly premium whether or not a claim has been settled under it. The second row is reached by coverage in force on some other premium arrangement under which no claim has been settled.

## What is read from the coverage record

The standing of the coverage, the premium it charges for one month and the count of claims settled under it come from the customer's coverage record under the Belrose Jewelry Protection and Care Plans; whether the premium is collected month by month or otherwise is the premium arrangement that coverage runs on.

## Illustrations (hypothetical)

- Coverage in force, premium collected month by month at 12.00 USD: 12.00 USD is presented.
- Coverage in force, premium collected in one payment, no claim settled under it: 2.00 USD is presented.
- Coverage in force, premium collected in one payment, one claim already settled under it: nothing is presented.
- Coverage that has lapsed: nothing is presented.
